mapper.select:
select MY.CURVE_DATE as curveDate, MY.CURVE_CODE as curveCode, MY.KEY_POINT as keyPoint, MY.YIELD*100 as yield, MY.CURVE_TYPE as curveType, MC.N as n, MC.K as k from MST_YIELD_CURVE_INFO MY INNER JOIN MST_CURVE_DEF MC on MC.CURVE_CODE = MY.CURVE_CODE
MY.CURVE_CODE like concat(concat('%', #{curveCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
AND MY.CURVE_TYPE like concat(concat('%', #{curveType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
AND TO_CHAR(MY.CURVE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{curveDate}
AND MY.CURVE_TYPE IN (SELECT ITEM_CODE FROM SYS_DATADICT_LIST WHERE DICT_CODE = #{curveIntType,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
order by curveDate, curveCode,keyPoint,yield,n,k

SELECT N n, K k FROM MST_CURVE_DEF WHERE
CURVE_CODE = #{curveCode}
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO MST_YIELD_CURVE_INFO CII USING (
select #{item.curveDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CURVE_DATE, #{item.curveCode,jdbcType=DATE} CURVE_CODE, #{item.keyPoint,jdbcType=VARCHAR} KEY_POINT, #{item.yield,jdbcType=DECIMAL}/100 YIELD, #{item.curveType,jdbcType=DECIMAL} CURVE_TYPE, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, sysdate CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, sysdate UPDATE_TIME, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT from dual
) TEMP
ON (CII.CURVE_DATE = TEMP.CURVE_DATE AND CII.CURVE_CODE = TEMP.CURVE_CODE AND CII.KEY_POINT = TEMP.KEY_POINT)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
CII.CURVE_TYPE = TEMP.CURVE_TYPE, CII.YIELD = TEMP.YIELD, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CURVE_DATE,CURVE_CODE,KEY_POINT,CURVE_TYPE,YIELD,CREATE_USER ,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT) values( TEMP.CURVE_DATE,TEMP.CURVE_CODE,TEMP.KEY_POINT,TEMP.CURVE_TYPE,TEMP.YIELD, TEMP.CREATE_USER,TEMP.CREATE_TIME,TEMP.UPDATE_USER,TEMP.UPDATE_TIME,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT )
